scope: Runtime split: every hosted runner compared with 1dab3c3 (same runner fix, unsplit runtime).
claims: same pass/fail/skip set as 1dab3c3; failing runners fail the same way except where noted

sources.relation: blob-identical to the commit (every tracked file)

environment.xmake: xmake v3.1.1+HEAD.3ba37a0, A cross-platform build utility based on Lua
environment.systoolchain: SysToolchain 0.1.0 release archives (one per triple), installed with --systoolchain_dir

commands.label: hosted runners
commands.command: for each scripts/test_<name>.py: python3 scripts/test_<name>.py [--output <dir>]  # runners needing any other required argument are recorded as skip

summary.note: native_poll and linux_rename already fail to link on 1dab3c3 (missing ok::arch::preflight_terminal_power_action). With the split they also list ok::arch::execution::ownership_report: in the single translation unit GCC proved that start() never records a shutdown owner when hw::supported() is false, so shutdown_report was dropped; with the owner shared between units it is kept. Kernel images always link an execution backend.
